segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including some with clogged or constantly congested pores, report effective, non-drying exfoliation with regular one-to-twice-weekly use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with normal-to-dry or dry and sensitive skin generally report smooth, hydrated results with no irritation, though one reviewer with normal, dry-leaning skin had the product ball up and stick uncomfortably to her facial hair despite her sister with dry, acne-prone skin having no such issue.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination-oily skin, including one who is acne-prone, report it doesn't cause breakouts the way other exfoliants have for them.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some with rosacea or hormonal sensitivity, mostly report no irritation or redness even with regular use, but one reviewer with a bad reaction specifically warns others with sensitive skin to be careful.
segments.normal: The one reviewer who describes her skin as normal, leaning dry, found the product balled up and stuck uncomfortably to her facial hair, an issue that didn't affect several of her sisters who tried the same tube.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the gel leaves skin hydrated and supple rather than tight or dry, unlike some other exfoliants they've tried, though one reviewer cautions that using it more than once a day can cause dryness or irritation.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers, including several with sensitive or rosacea-prone skin, report no redness or irritation even with regular use, but a couple describe irritation: one from applying too many layers near the nose, and another describing an outright bad reaction.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone or combination-acne skin report it doesn't trigger breakouts the way other exfoliants have, and one even used it to help a cystic pimple resolve faster; one reviewer, however, reports it caused breakouts every single time she used it over a month.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or clogged pores report effective oil and impurity removal with regular use, describing their skin as cleaner and more radiant afterward.

aspects.libelle: Balls up, clings to facial hair

extraits.texte: I've been using it for a month now, and I didn't like it after the first application. It immediately caused breakouts. I don't know, maybe my skin just reacts this way, but the result is always the same: every time I try it, I get pimples.
Bad reaction on my skin. Be careful if you have sensitive skin.

Purchased this after my younger sister (in her late 20s, dry skin, acne prone) raved about how soft and smooth it made her face look and feel. I’m not sure what’s wrong with my face, but when I used it (I have very normal skin, leaning more dry than oily), it balled up and STUCK to my face!! The balling up is normal she said, but having the minuscule balls stuck to the hairs on my face was definitely not normal. She said the balls (product and dead skin cells) should wash right off with water. I had to literally scrape my cheeks to get the tiny white balls off. I tried pre-washing my face before using this product, I tried using soap after using the product to remove the balls, I tried different methods to get it to work for me but it still kept balling up on my lower cheeks/jawline. It was the strangest thing. A couple of my other sisters purchased it and used it with no issues, but one of my older sisters (I have six sisters, so many testers) had the same balling effect happen to them, too! I wanted to love it and tried for weeks, but ended up giving it to one of my older sisters who didn’t have the issues I had with it.

I wouldn’t say low irritant exactly. This peeling gel was affective at removing dead skin and cleaning some whiteheads up. With that said I noticed by the 3rd layer around my nose would be left irritated. If I get this again in the future I will only go in with 2 layers.

This is the only product that has ACTUALLY smoothed my skin and made makeup application more even. I have combo/acne prone skin, this doesn't break me out like many other exfoliants tend to. I use this 1-2x a week, it's worked better than any other exfoliating product I've tried and I've tried many of them. It's also easier on the skin than microblading. I've used this on the body as well and it works fantastically - I just wish it was more cost effective to do on a regular basis.

It feels super comfortable on the skin. I have dry and sensitive skin and didn’t experience any irritation. The texture is very gentle yet it exfoliates and cleans from the first use. Since I don’t usually have many impurities this product worked perfectly for me. I’m not sure if it shows as much on camera but I definitely noticed a difference. These photos are after just one use.
I have oily skin and my pores are constantly clogged. I use this peeling gel twice a week, it cleanses pores very well, exfoliates dead cells, resulting in incredibly radiant skin.
